N13#1.zh: 报告观察！此地叫做蓼儿洼，邻近梁山泊；周围都是深湖水泽，加上比人还要高的芦苇，几乎连前方五尺的东西都看不清。这附近时常有强人出没，但是连官军也不敢轻易进剿...何观察，我看我们还是早点退兵吧...
N13#1.t: Report, Inspector! This place is called Liao'er Hollow, close to Liangshan Marsh. It's all deep lakes and marsh, with reeds taller than a man; you can hardly see five feet ahead. Bandits often roam around here, and even the army doesn't dare come in lightly... Inspector He, I think we'd better pull back soon...

N13#2.zh: 胆小鬼！谁要是敢退一步的话，就以阵前逃亡当场斩首！
N13#2.t: Coward! Anyone who takes one step back will be beheaded on the spot for desertion!

N13#3.t: Figures to the left and right!

N13#4.zh: 打鱼一世蓼儿洼，不种青苗不种麻。酷吏赃官都杀尽，忠臣报答赵官家！
N13#4.t: A lifetime fishing Liao'er Hollow, no rice I sow, no hemp I grow. Kill every cruel and grasping official, and loyal men will serve the Zhao throne!

N13#6.zh: 老爷生长石碣村，禀性生来要杀人。先斩何涛巡简首，京师献与赵王君！
N13#6.t: Born and raised in Stone Tablet Village, killing's in my blood. First I'll take Inspector He Tao's head, and send it to the Emperor in the capital!

N13#8.zh: 嘿！好大胆！居然敢两个人就来挑衅官军！阮小二不在，这两个人就没有什么好怕的！左右！先把这两个人捉起来！
N13#8.t: Hey! What nerve! Just two of you, daring to provoke the army! Without Ruan Xiao'er, these two are nothing to fear! Men! Seize these two first!

N13#10.zh: 胜利条件   --- 引诱何涛深入蓼儿洼
N13#10.t: Victory --- Lure He Tao deep into Liao'er Hollow

N13#11.zh: 失败条件一 --- 阮小五死亡

N13#12.zh: 失败条件二 --- 阮小七死亡

N13#13.zh: 诱敌任务失败，埋伏为官兵识破，无法得逞，在官兵围捕七昼夜后，众好汉终于不敌，曝尸荒野........
N13#13.t: The lure failed and the soldiers saw through the ambush. After seven days and nights of hunting, the heroes were finally overwhelmed and their bodies left in the wilds........

N13#14.zh: 『立地太岁』阮小二来也！老爷兄弟三个，向来只爱杀人放火！量你这厮算哪根葱！竟然敢带着官兵来捉我们？！今天让你们来的了、去不得！
N13#14.t: 'Earthly Demon' Ruan Xiao'er is here! We three brothers have only ever loved killing and burning! Who do you think you are, bringing soldiers to catch us?! Today you came, but you won't leave!

N13#15.zh: 不好！中了调虎离山之计！士兵们！快来保护我！
N13#15.t: Oh no! They lured us away from our ground! Soldiers! Protect me!

N13#17.zh: 胜利条件   --- 打败所有敌人

N13#19.zh: 失败条件二 --- 何涛逃跑

N13#20.zh: 限制回合数已到，未完成任务，游戏失败！

N13#21.zh: %N死亡后，众人被迫跳入水中水遁，无奈除了阮氏兄弟外，皆不识水性，于是好汉们一一成为浮尸........
N13#21.t: With %N dead, the others were forced to escape into the water. But apart from the Ruan brothers none of them could swim, and the heroes became floating corpses one after another........

N13#22.zh: 何涛逃出生天，立刻向高俅求援，高俅派出大军，火速赶往围捕，终将众好汉一网成擒，魂归离恨天........
N13#22.t: He Tao escaped with his life and at once asked Gao Qiu for help. Gao Qiu sent a great army racing to round them up, and in the end the heroes were caught in one net and their souls departed........

N13#23.zh: 忽地起一阵怪风，芦苇丛中火船齐出，官船烧作一片——船上那个先生，便是祭风的公孙胜。何涛的人马死的死、逃的逃，众好汉逃脱了官兵的追捕。
N13#23.t: Suddenly a strange wind rose. Fire boats burst out of the reeds together and the official boats went up in flames. The teacher on the boat was Gongsun Sheng, who had called up the wind. He Tao's men were killed or fled, and the heroes escaped the soldiers' pursuit.
